category: Archive and Protect Each Software Release (PS)
subcategory_text: Collect, protect, and retain evidence (e.g., test results, code-review records, audit logs) that demonstrate the software release meets the organisation's security requirements.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AU-2, AU-10, CA-2
implementation_examples: Store release-attestation evidence with the release archive
Retain evidence for at least the supported-lifetime of the release plus a defined buffer
Apply integrity protection to release-attestation evidence
assessment_objectives: Determine whether release-attestation evidence is collected and retained.
Determine whether evidence is protected from tampering.
